Default.note: Labelled brief field at a usable height, muted placeholder asking a real question, helper line underneath. Resize grip is the only ornament.

Filled.note: A genuine two-paragraph brief; line length and leading read comfortably, and the character count sits in meta.

Invalid.note: Destructive border plus a destructive sentence that says what to do, not just that something is wrong.

Disabled.note: Drops to 50% with the content still legible, and the helper states the reason it is read-only.
